[Q02](#research-q02) staged/running门→锁内attempt落盘→真实子Agent/FIFO投递；[Q03](#research-q03)身份/attempt/邮箱；[Q04](#research-q04)质量证据与真实字节审计；[Q05](#research-q05)Host请求准入、halt/drain及归档。

0.1.29/MIT原生Host工具与Web插件；Node^22.19.0或>=24、DSH最低声明与README推荐Host分开，实际包/兼容矩阵未运行验收。

| 阶段 | 现金与资源 | 人工与时间 |
|---|---|---|
| 首次 | Host/模型/本地存储未知 | 版本/角色/DAG/预算/验收配置分钟未知 |
| 持续 | 队长/多成员上下文、worker/邮箱/状态未知 | 核交接、真测试和整合，净节时未测 |
| 失败恢复 | 冷重跑/冲突/追加模型资源未知 | task/邮箱/文件/Host对账与恢复分钟未知 |
| 退出 | 归档/会话/外部数据保留资源未知 | 核drain、残留与备份，已写不可假定回滚 |
[Q06](#research-q06) 两成员只读评审、显式required和后续用户批准、固定预算/完成原件，按[Q04](#research-q04)核真实命令与字节。停队后独立核Host/工作区，未确认不重派写；归档保留，再回单Agent/人工清单，别把关标签/delete当擦除。

| 效果项 | 当前源码支持 | 尚不能证明 |
|---|---|---|
| 分工 | 持久DAG/assignee/attempt与自动领取 | 并行加速/少协调的真实净收益 |
| 归属 | stale任务/邮件拒绝，fork lead识别 | 文件/网络Exactly once或账户隔离 |
| 质量 | 结构证据、revision/gap及有界复审 | 命令真实通过/报告准确/安全合并 |
| 停止 | halted持久、递归drain与归档 | 所有工具静止、数据全删/副作用撤回 |
| 方向 | 写前能力可提出实验 | 未实现/未验，不计现有保障 |
[Q02](#research-q02)驻留park与冷恢复精确回退、[Q03](#research-q03)身份/attempt/邮箱以及[Q04](#research-q04)revision审计与有界修复有局部价值；状态/消息能力、工具集合、声明范围与真实副作用四层分开，不用README安全词或测试规模代运行证据。
[Q02](#research-q02)和[Q03](#research-q03)将依赖、执行归属与成员续跑/邮箱持久化，[Q04](#research-q04)把验收声明、审查字节绑定和失败repair/recheck交接纳入任务状态，是超出团队UI的分工机制。Host子Agent/模型/工具与文件权限继承外部；attempt/审计/工具filter分别约束不同层，不能归为写入沙箱。

[Q02](#research-q02)批准confirmation非空不是用户新turn授权证明，accepted非完成；[Q03](#research-q03)attempt只约束团队状态/消息，[Q04](#research-q04)验收命令/changedPaths仍有成员自报、实际范围审计在后，[Q05](#research-q05)halt先状态后drain且delete是归档。负责人必须核真实工作区、外部副作用与成本。
[Q07](#research-q07)在Host实际操作前绑定member/attempt/真实path能力，转派撤销旧能力；对照已有声明重叠+工具filter、独立工作区/人工合并，测越界/旧attempt写、误拒与恢复分钟。已有create scope门不当新发明；Host不可拦、独立工作区等价或负担更高即推翻，未实现。

| 依赖或条件 | 具体版本/作用 | 缺失或边界 |
|---|---|---|
| 插件 | @nanmicoder/dsh-agent-teams0.1.29，MIT | Host+可选Web，发行包未验 |
| Node/DSH | Node^22.19.0或>=24；声明DSH>=0.1.2-alpha.2 | 推荐0.2.1-rc.2，0.2.2rc1适配声明非本轮运行 |
| 子Agent provider | 默认spawn，continuable/persona/filter或managed API | 首次spawn查能力，缺失报错 |
| Host工具/模型/权限 | 负责真实推理、工具和递归drain | 插件状态门非OS隔离 |
| 本地状态/worker | .agent-teams JSON/JSONL与审计worker/hash | 明文、同进程锁，磁盘/跨进程另核 |

technical.rationale: [Q02](#research-q02)至[Q05](#research-q05)：novelty9是子Agent/持久任务图/邮箱/质量流程组合到DSH的有限新接缝，超过无适配0；不是新并行计算或Agent算法到18。mechanism15的锁内generation、驻留park/cold恢复、来源attempt、review digest/gap和有界repair对局部重派/陈旧结果作取舍，超过薄入口8；相对手工子Agent关键共享文件/外部副作用与强批准仍未解决，不到23。transferability10的attempt/消息/审查字节绑定可迁移其他任务调度，超私有页面5；Host activation/fork能力强依赖、process-local锁/冷恢复/不确定drain是主要反例，未验跨Host不取15。simplification8共享scheduler/持久状态和质量回路减少手工逐个唤醒/重新连线，超过小入口4；复杂Host兼容、审计/恢复/人工验收和锁域维护未测净减少，不到11。

business.rationale: [Q02](#research-q02)/[Q04](#research-q04)：workflow18依据真实captain/member assignee、依赖就绪领取、attempt交接、失败repair→recheck与升级负责人，改变可持续任务分工/交接而非集中入口，超过只局部自动化9；人类批准主要协议、验收自报与整合/副作用仍人工，缺组织运行对照不到26。delivery8以任务输出/findings/acceptance/commands及真实artifact revision/gaps共同保留交付证据，超过只聊天展示0；直接替代可用人工报告/日志达到同类交付，未证独立质量验收提升到15。reach0仍需负责人拆分/Host/provider/复核能力，未识别此前明确被排除人群到5。economics0相对手工子Agent同用户提供模型/工具资源、凭据、协调与恢复，异构模型快照/并行不等于供给/计费或服务责任结构改变到4；总费用未知另列缺口，不按潜在节时加分。

recommendation.reason: 能拆分任务并承担验收整合的 DSH 负责人，可固定 0.1.29 与 Host/provider，在独立低权限工作区用两名成员做只读评审。它比手工建子 Agent 多接好了持久依赖、attempt 归属、邮箱与修复复审交接，但批准协议、成员自报证据和共享文件副作用仍需负责人核实。出现重复执行、审批或范围不清、停止未确认或费用超预算就暂停并独立查 Host/工作区，保留归档后回单 Agent 串行和人工清单接手。

scenario.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01)具体可拆/可复核任务与[Q02](#research-q02)持久依赖/续跑明确，超过一般用途15；缺真实用户频次/重要性证据，不到30。

advantage.rationale: [Q02](#research-q02)锁内attempt/自动调度与[Q04](#research-q04)有界repair-recheck/字节绑定相对人工子Agent清单有可解释协调增量，超仅UI6；[Q03](#research-q03)副作用/锁域及[Q05](#research-q05)停队部分失败、无净质量/成本对照不到19。

evidence.rationale: [Q02](#research-q02)create/approve/scheduler→真实Host创建投递、[Q03](#research-q03)落盘/attempt/邮件、[Q04](#research-q04)gate/audit→worker/hash与[Q05](#research-q05)drain/archive失败核到callee，超过schema6；限定代表链、没执行Host/模型/恢复/效果，不到19。

cost.rationale: [Q06](#research-q06)两成员只读/独立工作区/预算与单Agent退路可局部控制，超过无可行恢复0；模型总用量、共享文件冲突、冷恢复重复和halt部分失败需人工核，费用/人时/完整退出未知，不到10。

publication.summaries.text: 为 DSH 提供队长与可续聊成员、依赖任务、持久邮箱、质量门禁和 Web 团队视图。

研究问题与完整回答 **插件研究总目标**：核团队从计划到真实成员执行、任务/消息、质量与停队归档的状态和副作用边界，推导采用与生产方向。 ### Q01 · 什么任务需要团队，当前插件和 Host 条件是什么？ **研究主题**：场景与需求、依赖、兼容与流程、贡献与相对优势 #### 完整回答 本项是 @nanmicoder/dsh-agent-teams 0.1.29/MIT，Node ^22.19.0或>=24、包engines.dsh>=0.1.2-alpha.2，原生Host工具+Web客户端插件。README推荐Host0.2.1-rc.2并说明0.2.2-rc.1适配，不把最低声明或矩阵当本轮实际安装/模型可用；首次spawn还要已注册continuable provider及对应能力。Web观察入口是可选，不挂Web仍可工具运行。 场景是负责人能拆出独立工作、定义先后依赖和验收，并承担汇总/合并复核；成功不只是多Agent同时有输出，而是正确归属/顺序、质量结果可追到当前字节且未覆盖他人工作。直接替代是手动创建子Agent、共享任务清单和人工发消息。插件多做持久DAG、attempt归属、自动就绪领取、成员直接邮箱和质量修复/复审交接，真实分工增量应和界面便利分开；未证并行更快或净成本更低。 Host apply解析owner toolPolicies，默认stateDir .agent-teams、memberProvider spawn、memberMaxDepth0/maxMembers8，注册团队工具和capability；slash command默认开，Web依赖服务迟绑定。默认最大人数不是推荐并发或费用上限，成员模型/工具服务依赖Host和外部provider。此次完整重核旧五题与12findings，代表实际建队/批准/派发、任务/消息、质量、halt/archive链，不全审全部profile、UI绘图、每Host兼容分支或模型效果。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 源码核查**：[package.json:1-18](https://github.com/NanmiCoder/dsh-agent-teams/blob/369c2785c473e546124ab1709664058e6ea93948/package.json#L1-L18) 插件版本与Host/client双导出。

      "content": "<p align=\"right\">\n  <strong>English</strong> · <a href=\"./README_ZH.md\">简体中文</a>\n</p>\n\n<p align=\"center\">\n  <img src=\"./assets/readme/hero.svg\" width=\"100%\" alt=\"dsh-agent-teams turns one DeepSeek Harness session into a coordinated multi-agent team\">\n</p>\n\n<div align=\"center\">\n\n[![AtomGit](https://atomgit.com/NanmiCoder/dsh-agent-teams/star/new_badge.svg)](https://atomgit.com/NanmiCoder/dsh-agent-teams)\n\n</div>\n\n<p align=\"center\">\n  <a href=\"https://dshfind.com/en/plugins/NanmiCoder/dsh-agent-teams?ref=badge\"><img src=\"https://img.shields.io/badge/recommended%20by-dshfind-FFD700?style=flat-square\" alt=\"Recommended by dshfind\"></a>\n  <a href=\"https://dshfind.com/en/plugins/NanmiCoder/dsh-agent-teams?ref=badge\"><img src=\"https://dshfind.com/api/badge/NanmiCoder/dsh-agent-teams?lang=en\" alt=\"dshfind score\"></a>\n  <a href=\"https://dshfind.com/en/plugins/NanmiCoder/dsh-agent-teams?ref=badge\"><img src=\"https://dshfind.com/api/badge/NanmiCoder/dsh-agent-teams?metric=downloads&lang=en\" alt=\"dshfind downloads\"></a>\n</p>\n\n<p align=\"center\">\n  <a href=\"https://www.npmjs.com/package/@nanmicoder/dsh-agent-teams\"><img src=\"https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@nanmicoder/dsh-agent-teams?style=flat-square&color=5B4CF0\" alt=\"npm version\"></a>\n  <a href=\"./LICENSE\"><img src=\"https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-0B7285?style=flat-square\" alt=\"MIT license\"></a>\n  <a href=\"./cordis.patch.yml\"><img src=\"https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-Web%20%2B%20Headless-5B4CF0?style=flat-square\" alt=\"DSH Web and Headless\"></a>\n</p>\n\n## One prompt. A working team.\n\n`dsh-agent-teams` turns the current DeepSeek Harness session into a captain that can assemble durable sub-agents, split a goal into dependency-aware tasks, and coordinate work through direct messages.\n\nAsk in natural language. The plugin provides the team protocol, 14 coordination tools, persistent state, an automatic shared-task scheduler, and a live Web UI—without requiring a separate workflow engine.\n\n<p align=\"center\">\n  <img src=\"./assets/readme/workspace.png\" width=\"100%\" alt=\"AgentTeams native workspace with members, task dependencies, and progress\">\n</p>\n\n## Releases\n\n[Latest release](https://github.com/NanmiCoder/dsh-agent-teams/releases/latest) restores member model fallback on Harness `0.2.2-rc.1` and improves task settlement, activity updates, and artifact auditing. The recommended host is Harness `0.2.1-rc.2`. See the [tested matrix](./compatibility.json) and [release notes](./release-notes/v0.1.29.md).\n\n## Why AgentTeams?\n\n| Capability | What it changes |\n| --- | --- |\n| **Captain-led delegation** | The current session creates the team, assigns roles, and consolidates the final result. |\n| **Durable members** | Members are continuable DSH sub-agents that can be woken for focused follow-up turns. |\n| **Dependency-aware tasks** | Tasks move through explicit states and cannot be claimed before their dependencies finish. |\n| **Automatic reuse and safe takeover** | Idle members claim the next ready task; reassignment revokes stale attempts before new work starts, and cold recovery retries stranded open attempts. |\n| **Direct messaging** | Members send durable mailbox messages directly to teammates or the captain—no relay required. |\n| **Live activity panel** | The Web UI combines segmented progress, a collapsible roster, and an interactive task DAG; running tasks show the member's model, and completed archives retain their full member and task history. |\n| **Plan before execution** | Normal `/agent-teams` runs stage an unspawned roster and DAG first. The Web panel uses the host model catalog for member routes. Returning to chat stops the planning turn, asks what should change, and revises the same draft; discarding archives the draft, aborts the turn, and explicitly prevents automatic recreation. Only **Approve & Run** enables scheduling; each member starts with its first ready task. |\n| **Quality gates** | Opt-in quality tasks support requirements → implementation → verification → review → integration contracts, automatic repair/re-review, and explicit resume. Scope control is a completion-time audit, not host write interception. See [docs/quality-gates.md](./docs/quality-gates.md). |\n\nThe conversation card and activity panel use Harness's official locale service. They follow live language changes between English and Simplified Chinese—including status labels, dynamic summaries, controls, archive markers, and accessibility text—without a page reload or a separate plugin setting.\n\n## Install and choose versions\n\n**Recommended pair: DeepSeek Harness `0.2.1-rc.2` + AgentTeams `0.1.29`. The host remains an RC.**\n\n| Use case | DeepSeek Harness | AgentTeams plugin |\n| --- | --- | --- |\n| **Recommended** | **`0.2.1-rc.2`** | **`0.1.29`** |\n| Preview host | `0.2.2-rc.1`, `0.2.1-rc.3` | `0.1.29` |\n| Previous recommended RC | `0.2.1-rc.1`, `0.2.0-rc.2`, `0.1.7-rc.2` | `0.1.29` |\n| Legacy RC | `0.1.5-rc.1`, `0.1.5-rc.2`, `0.1.5-rc.3` | `0.1.29` |\n| Retaining an older RC | `0.1.2-rc.1` | `0.1.29` |\n| Developer Alpha testing | `0.1.2-alpha.5` | `0.1.29` |\n| Retaining an older Alpha | `0.1.2-alpha.2` | `0.1.29` |\n| Other installable hosts | At or above `0.1.2-alpha.2` | `0.1.29` |\n\nCI verifies the exact hosts listed above the last row. The installer accepts other hosts at or above the minimum version.\n\n### Desktop app\n\nIn the app sidebar, open **Plugins → Add plugin**. You can install directly from GitHub by pasting this repository URL into the plugin input, without a version, tag, or commit suffix:\n\n```text\nhttps://github.com/NanmiCoder/dsh-agent-teams\n```\n\nThis installs from the default branch and is available immediately after release. The equivalent shorthand is also supported:\n\n```text\ngithub:NanmiCoder/dsh-agent-teams\n```\n\nFor npm installation, enter the versioned spec `@nanmicoder/dsh-agent-teams@0.1.29`. Desktop's pnpm 11 defaults to a 24-hour minimum release age: for 24 hours after a release, a bare package name or `@latest` installs the previous version even when the preview shows the newest one, and the installation fails if that version is incompatible with your host. An exact version installs immediately. Changing registry mirrors does not remove this policy. GitHub access is required for the Git route; it may contain newer code than npm.\n\nInstall it, then choose **Enable now**. If the host asks for a restart, restart the desktop app. Do not disable compatibility checks or the global release-age policy to install the plugin.\n\nThe desktop app supplies its own Harness core and package manager. Upgrading the global CLI does not upgrade that core, and an ordinary standalone CLI cannot manage its desktop profile. The CLI carrier installed by the desktop app can manage that profile in `0.2.1-rc.2`. Check the embedded core against the compatibility list. Harness `0.2.1-rc.2` is now the exact published target; its RC status is unchanged. The earlier source-only `0.2.0` prediction is no longer a support declaration. See the [release migration evidence](./docs/harness-0.2.1-rc.2/README.md).\n\n### CLI / Web: 1. Install DeepSeek Harness\n\n```sh\nnpm install --global @deepseek-ai/dsh\ndsh --version\n```\n\nThe command selects the host's npm `latest`; check `dsh --version` against the support matrix after upgrading. Alpha is opt-in: select an exact Alpha version from the table and lock all host dependencies as described in the [maintenance guide](./docs/maintenance-workflow.md).\n\n### CLI / Web: 2. Install the AgentTeams plugin\n\nInstall or upgrade from npm with an exact version (currently `0.1.29`):\n\n```sh\ndsh plugin --profile web add --save-exact @nanmicoder/dsh-agent-teams@0.1.29\n```\n\nFor a CLI-managed installation, replace `web` with your active CLI profile. **Stop and restart that profile's Harness process, then refresh the browser.** Installing the plugin does not upgrade Harness; the host and plugin have independent `latest` channels.\n\nAlternatively, install or update from the latest GitHub default branch without a tag or commit suffix:\n\n```sh\ndsh plugin --profile web add github:NanmiCoder/dsh-agent-teams\n```\n\nTo update, run the command again with the new version, then restart the profile; a bare package name can retain an already installed exact version. For 24 hours after a release, a bare package name or `@latest` installs the previous version. If a registry mirror has not synced the release, append `--registry=https://registry.npmjs.org` to the npm command. GitHub default-branch code may be newer than npm `latest`. The default branch includes the verified server, client, and type build outputs in `lib/`. The repository distributes these outputs so installation does not need a `prepare` hook or build-script approval. Source maintainers must run `pnpm build` and update the committed outputs whenever the source changes. Existing npm releases remain immutable.\n\nFor a manually cloned checkout, run `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` and `pnpm build` after pulling, then restart the corresponding Harness process. Updating Git alone does not update local build output. See the [maintenance guide](./docs/maintenance-workflow.md).\n\n> For `0.1.0-*` / `0.1.1-*` hosts older than `0.1.2-alpha.2`, keep a working pair and follow the [older-version and diagnostic guide](./docs/maintenance-workflow.md).\n\nSee the full [compatibility matrix](./compatibility.json), [source installation and Alpha testing guide](./docs/maintenance-workflow.md), and [verification coverage and platform limits](./docs/maintenance-2026-09-06/release/README.md).\n\nThen ask for a team directly:\n\n> Use AgentTeams to review the commits after v0.5.3 from performance, security, and product perspectives. Return one consolidated report.\n\n## View teams in the workspace\n\nClick **View team** in the current chat header or the team card below a reply to open the native **Team collaboration** tab. The entry belongs to its chat, rather than the general workspace start page.\n\nTeam and task content starts immediately: wide panes use columns and narrow panes stack them. Select a task to locate its owner; member icons open their conversations. Closing the tab does not stop the team, and its chat can reopen it. Completed teams retain their archives. Older hosts keep the activity panel.\n\n## How it works\n\n1. For a request to use AgentTeams, the captain follows the core protocol already in its system instructions. It continues an existing team and uses `agent_teams_status` when current state needs checking. When no team exists, the goal becomes a staged plan for review.\n2. The captain adds role-specific members backed by continuable sub-agents.\n3. The goal becomes tasks with owners and explicit dependencies.\n4. The shared scheduler uses real `running / idle / ready` state to atomically claim one ready task per idle member and wake it. An interrupted resident attempt stays parked and can resume through a direct message without losing its capability; after a cold process restart, the scheduler retries stranded open work with a fresh attempt.\n5. Members update with the current `attempt_id`; reassignment or captain takeover revokes the old attempt and waits for the old worker to quiesce before a new attempt starts.\n6. The captain presents the combined result, then archives the complete team record.\n\nTeam state is stored under `<workspace>/.agent-teams/`; the Web panel reads that disk truth and combines it with live sub-agent activity.\n\nMember creation is zero-interaction by default: a member on the captain's current LLM route snapshots that provider, model, and reasoning effort, while a member on a requested alternative route snapshots the target model's default effort; later continuations restore the resolved snapshot. Only an explicit heterogeneous-team request (for example, “backend on provider A/model X, frontend on provider B/model Y”) supplies a member-specific `provider` + `model`; there is no per-member model or reasoning prompt.\n\nCaptain sessions keep the concise core protocol and the original 14 native team tools from their first request. All business tools are directly available; no loading tool or extra activation call is needed. Configured profiles retain their bounded directory in the fixed system prompt. Creating, approving, continuing or ending a team does not rewrite the system prompt or tool schemas. Core rules remain available after history compaction or discarded code-mode tool results. Members receive four team tools, fixed member instructions, and their ordinary coding/research tools. Web approval wakes the captain with a control message; later member reports wake it again. See the [fixed protocol and benchmark contract](./docs/progressive-loading.md).\n\n## Slash command\n\nNo “use AgentTeams” phrasing required. The plugin registers the\nclosed-namespace `/agent-teams` host command, so the Web GUI slash menu shows\nan `agent-teams` placeholder with an input hint: pick it (or type the\ncommand), describe the goal, and press Enter.\n\n```\n/agent-teams research the pricing pages of three competitors\n```\n\nThe command pipeline claims the line, then preserves that exact input as an\nordinary user follow-up so it remains visible in the main chat. The gesture\nboundary adds the deterministic activation directive at pre-step, so the\nfirst model request follows the staged planning protocol without a mandatory helper call. The invocation is also durably\nlogged (`command/run` / `command/done`).\n\nSurfaces without command adjudication (for example the headless CLI) get the\nsame deterministic activation through a gesture boundary: any genuine user\nmessage starting with `/agent-teams` activates the protocol for the rest of\nthe text. Mid-sentence mentions stay ordinary prose.\n\nHistorical panels require saved team state or archives. Sessions from early versions that deleted teams without retaining archives do not yet support reconstructing the full panel from logs.\n\n## Configuration\n\nDefaults work without extra setup. A trusted profile can override member behavior:\n\n```yaml\n- id: agent-teams\n  config:\n    stateDir: .agent-teams\n    memberProvider: spawn\n    memberModel: deepseek-v4\n    memberMaxDepth: 0\n    maxMembers: 8\n    toolPolicies:\n      researcher:\n        allow: [read, glob, grep]\n      implementer:\n        deny: [web_search]\n```\n\n`memberMaxDepth` defaults to `0`: team members cannot create nested subagents. Set `1` to explicitly permit one descendant level; the limit also covers runtime/code-tool calls. Default members report through team messages only, avoiding duplicate native parent reports. Idle roster members make no model requests. Task assignments start distinct turns; coordination joins the nearest model step. Acceptance and consumption are tracked separately. Removal/archive drains the selected branch and its pending input before reporting success.\n\n`toolPolicies` is owner configuration: reusable per-member tool policies keyed by id. A member *selects* one by id — `tool_policy` on `agent_teams_add_member`, a member row of an inline `plan`, or a profile member row. The Captain model can select a declared policy but can never submit raw allow/deny lists or invent one at runtime.\n\n- `deny` hides the named global tools from that member's schemas and rejects their invocation.\n- `allow` keeps only the named global tools. The four coordination tools (`agent_teams_claim_task`, `agent_teams_update_task`, `agent_teams_send_message`, `agent_teams_status`) are always added to an allow list.\n- The captain-only tool list is always denied and cannot be reopened by a policy; a policy may not deny a required coordination tool.\n- Unknown ids, empty policies, and empty lists fail at mount or before a member is persisted.\n- `agent_teams_status` shows the selected policy id per member; the complete resolved filter is kept in `team.json` for audit, and the child's durable descriptor reapplies it after a restart.\n- Teams and members created without a policy keep their previous tool set and record shape. An empty `tool_policy` on `agent_teams_edit_plan` clears a staged member's policy.\n\nThis is model tool visibility and invocation policy for global tools, not an OS sandbox or an authorization boundary.\n\n`memberProvider` is the sub-agent runtime backend (`spawn` / `fork`), not an LLM provider. Cross-LLM-provider routing uses the optional `provider` + `model` fields of `agent_teams_add_member`; `memberModel` is only a model default for all members. A member on the captain's current provider/model inherits the captain's reasoning effort, while a changed provider or model automatically uses the target model's default. To request a particular effort, pass the optional `reasoning_effort` field — one of the target model's supported effort ids, or `\"default\"` to force the model's own default.\n\n`slashCommand: false` disables the deterministic `/agent-teams` activation surfaces (slash command and gesture boundary), leaving the natural-language trigger as the only entry point.\n\n## Boundaries\n\n- One captain leads one active team at a time.\n- Idle members with no open task are automatically reused for ready work. An idle member that still owns an open attempt is parked until messaged or explicitly reassigned; messages that cannot be delivered live remain durable and are retried at a later status boundary.\n- State is file-backed and serialized within one DSH process; concurrent processes editing the same team are not coordinated.\n- The activity panel reports persisted state as-is. Models may occasionally finish work without performing the expected task-state update.\n\nSee [docs/usage.md](./docs/usage.md) for the full tool reference, state model, Web UI behavior, configuration, and known limits.\n\n## Plugin development Skill\n\nCommunity upgrade, audit, benchmark, testing and release skills are vendored with a pinned source revision. See [skills/README.md](./skills/README.md) for local rules and [CONTRIBUTING.md](./CONTRIBUTING.md) for the contribution workflow.\n\nThe repository also ships the open Agent Skills package [`dsh-plugin-development`](./skills/dsh-plugin-development/SKILL.md):\n\n```sh\nnpx skills add NanmiCoder/dsh-agent-teams --skill dsh-plugin-development\n```\n\n## Documentation\n\n| Guide | Covers |\n| --- | --- |\n| [Usage](./docs/usage.md) | Architecture, UI behavior, tools, configuration, limits, and validation |\n| [Verification](./docs/verification-guide.md) | Offline, composition, real e2e, and GUI verification |\n| [Plugin development](./docs/developing-dsh-plugins.md) | Human-readable guide built from this plugin |\n| [README writing](./docs/readme-writing-guide.md) | Repository documentation conventions |\n\n## Development\n\n```sh\npnpm install\npnpm build\npnpm verify\n```\n\n## Named multi-role profiles\n\nConfigure one or more complete team profiles in `cordis.patch.yml`. A profile always supplies the roster (independent provider/model/role/reasoning effort). Set `taskPlanning: captain` when the Captain should derive the DAG from the user's goal; omit it or set `taskPlanning: seed` to keep a fixed template workflow:\n\n```yaml\nprofiles:\n  demo-delivery:\n    description: Ship a small feature\n    protocol: Discuss requirements, review, test, then prepare release; do not deploy automatically.\n    members:\n      - name: analyst\n        model: gpt-5.6-sol\n        role: Analyze requirements\n      - name: implementer\n        model: gpt-5.6-terra\n        role: Implement the approved solution\n    tasks:\n      - id: requirements\n        subject: Requirements discussion\n        assignee: analyst\n      - id: implementation\n        subject: Implement solution\n        assignee: implementer\n        dependencies: [requirements]\n```\n\nUse an explicit profile flag: `/agent-teams --profile demo-delivery implement the feature`. The first ordinary token is never treated as an implicit profile. Normal command runs call `agent_teams_create({ profile, approval: \"required\" })`: the roster and seed/Captain-designed DAG remain staged, no child session is created, and no task is claimed. Edit the plan in the activity panel using the host model catalog, return to chat so the Captain asks what to revise and then atomically updates the same draft, discard it, or click **Approve & Run**. Return/discard actions cancel any planning turn still running; discard also parks model-facing context that forbids silently creating a replacement team. Approval resolves the final provider/model/reasoning choices, commits the roster, and creates each member session only when its first task is ready. A running team is stopped from its own panel header through a confirmation dialog rather than from the composer. Direct tool clients may pass `approval: \"automatic\"` for the legacy immediate path. Failed review/test tasks do not unlock downstream work; automatic repair/review tasks do not depend on the failed review.\n\n## License\n\n[MIT](./LICENSE)\n"

src=\"https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-Web%20%2B%20Headless-5B4CF0?style=flat-square\" alt=\"DSH Web 与 Headless\"></a>\n</p>\n\n## 一句话，拉起一支真正协作的团队\n\n`dsh-agent-teams` 让当前 DeepSeek Harness 会话成为队长：创建可续聊的子 Agent、把目标拆成有依赖的任务，并通过直达消息协调成员工作。\n\n你只需用自然语言提出目标。插件会提供精简的固定团队协议、14 个业务工具、持久化状态、自动共享任务调度和实时 Web UI，不需要额外的 Workflow 引擎。\n\n<p align=\"center\">\n  <img src=\"./assets/readme/workspace.png\" width=\"100%\" alt=\"DeepSeek Harness 对话与 AgentTeams 实时活动面板，展示成员、任务依赖和回报\">\n</p>\n\n## 版本更新\n\n[最新发布](https://github.com/NanmiCoder/dsh-agent-teams/releases/latest) 恢复 Harness `0.2.2-rc.1` 的成员模型回退，并改进任务收尾、活动更新和交付物审计。推荐宿主为 Harness `0.2.1-rc.2`。详见[测试矩阵](./compatibility.json)和[发布说明](./release-notes/v0.1.29.md)。\n\n## 为什么需要 AgentTeams？\n\n| 能力 | 带来的变化 |\n| --- | --- |\n| **队长式委派** | 当前会话负责建队、分配角色并汇总最终结果。 |\n| **可续聊成员** | 成员是可持续唤醒的 DSH 子 Agent，可以继续执行聚焦的后续轮次。 |\n| **带依赖的任务** | 任务有明确状态；依赖未完成时不能领取。 |\n| **自动续领与安全接管** | 成员空闲后自动领取下一项就绪任务；转派会撤销旧 attempt，冷恢复会重试遗留任务，迟到结果无法覆盖。 |\n| **成员直达消息** | 成员通过持久化邮箱直接联系队友或队长，不需要队长中转。 |\n| **实时活动面板** | Web UI 用分段进度、可折叠成员树和可交互 DAG 展示实时工作；运行中的子任务会标出使用的模型，团队结束后仍保留完整成员与任务历史。 |\n| **质量门禁** | 人只提供目标和约束。默认任务顺序是需求 → 实现 → 验证 → 审查 → 集成，失败后自动修复/复审，恢复团队必须显式 resume。第一版范围控制是完成时审计，不是 host 写入拦截。详见 [docs/quality-gates.md](./docs/quality-gates.md)。 |\n\n对话卡片与活动面板接入 Harness 官方多语言服务，会随宿主在简体中文和英文之间实时切换；任务/成员状态、动态摘要、操作按钮、历史归档标识和无障碍文案都会同步更新，无需刷新页面，也不增加插件自己的语言设置。\n\n## 安装与版本选择\n\n**推荐组合：DeepSeek Harness `0.2.1-rc.2` + AgentTeams `0.1.29`。宿主仍为 RC 版本。**\n\n| 使用场景 | DeepSeek Harness | AgentTeams 插件 |\n| --- | --- | --- |\n| **推荐版本** | **`0.2.1-rc.2`** | **`0.1.29`** |\n| 预览宿主 | `0.2.2-rc.1`、`0.2.1-rc.3` | `0.1.29` |\n| 上一推荐 RC | `0.2.1-rc.1`, `0.2.0-rc.2`, `0.1.7-rc.2` | `0.1.29` |\n| 保留旧 RC | `0.1.5-rc.1`, `0.1.5-rc.2`, `0.1.5-rc.3` | `0.1.29` |\n| 保留旧 RC | `0.1.2-rc.1` | `0.1.29` |\n| 开发者测试 Alpha | `0.1.2-alpha.5` | `0.1.29` |\n| 保留旧 Alpha | `0.1.2-alpha.2` | `0.1.29` |\n| 其他可安装宿主 | `0.1.2-alpha.2` 及以上 | `0.1.29` |\n\nCI 验证表中最后一行之前的精确宿主版本。安装器也接受达到最低版本要求的其他宿主。\n\n### 桌面端\n\n在应用侧栏打开「插件 → 添加插件」，可以直接通过 GitHub 地址安装。在插件输入框中粘贴下面的仓库地址，无需追加版本号、tag 或 commit：\n\n```text\nhttps://github.com/NanmiCoder/dsh-agent-teams\n```\n\n此方式从默认分支安装，刚发布后即可使用。也支持下面的等价简写：\n\n```text\ngithub:NanmiCoder/dsh-agent-teams\n```\n\n从 npm 安装时输入带版本号的包名 `@nanmicoder/dsh-agent-teams@0.1.29`。桌面端的 pnpm 11 默认不自动安装发布未满 24 小时的版本：新版发布后的 24 小时内，不带版本号或使用 `@latest` 都会装到上一个版本，即使预览显示的是新版；如果上一个版本与你的宿主不兼容，安装会失败。写明版本号可以立即安装该版本；更换镜像源不会消除这项规则。GitHub 方式需要能够访问 GitHub，默认分支代码可能先于 npm 发布。\n\n安装完成后点击「立即启用」；宿主提示需要重启时，重启桌面应用。无需关闭兼容检查或全局发布等待期规则。\n\n桌面端自带 Harness 内核与包管理器，升级全局 CLI 不会升级桌面端；普通独立 CLI 不能管理桌面 profile，桌面端自带的 CLI carrier 在此版本可以管理。当前精确目标是已发布的 `0.2.1-rc.2`，仍属于 RC；此前源码预测的 `0.2.0` 已退出支持声明。详见[迁移验收记录](./docs/harness-0.2.1-rc.2/README.md)。\n\n### CLI / Web：1. 安装 DeepSeek Harness\n\n```sh\nnpm install --global @deepseek-ai/dsh\ndsh --version\n```\n\n此命令安装宿主的 npm `latest`；升级后请用 `dsh --version` 对照兼容清单。Alpha 仅供主动测试：手动指定表中的 Alpha 版本，并按[维护指南](./docs/maintenance-workflow.md)锁定整组宿主依赖。\n\n### CLI / Web：2. 安装 AgentTeams 插件\n\n从 npm 安装或升级插件时写明版本号（当前正式版为 `0.1.29`）：\n\n```sh\ndsh plugin --profile web add --save-exact @nanmicoder/dsh-agent-teams@0.1.29\n```\n\nCLI 管理的安装可将 `web` 换成实际使用的 CLI profile。**安装后，停止并重新启动该 profile 的 Harness 进程，再刷新浏览器。** 安装插件不会自动升级宿主；Harness 的 `latest` 与插件的 `latest` 是两个独立渠道。\n\n也可以从 GitHub 默认分支安装或更新，无需追加 tag 或 commit：\n\n```sh\ndsh plugin --profile web add github:NanmiCoder/dsh-agent-teams\n```\n\n更新时把命令里的版本号换成新版本再运行，然后重启对应 profile；已有安装只重复裸包名时，包管理器可能保留旧的精确版本。不带版本号或使用 `@latest` 时，新版发布后的 24 小时内会装到上一个版本。镜像源尚未同步新发布时，可在 npm 命令后追加 `--registry=https://registry.npmjs.org`。GitHub 默认分支的代码可能先于 npm `latest` 发布；默认分支包含已验证的 `lib/` 构建产物。仓库随代码分发服务端、客户端和类型产物，安装时不需要执行 `prepare` 或批准构建脚本。源码维护者每次修改源码后，都需运行 `pnpm build` 并更新已提交的产物。已经发布的 npm 产物保持不变。\n\n手动克隆源码的用户，拉取代码后需重新运行 `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` 和 `pnpm build`，再重启对应的 Harness；只更新 Git 不会更新本地构建产物。详见[维护指南](./docs/maintenance-workflow.md)。\n\n> 低于 `0.1.2-alpha.2` 的旧 `0.1.0-*` / `0.1.1-*` 宿主，请先保留已工作的组合，参考[旧版本与诊断指引](./docs/maintenance-workflow.md)。\n\n完整[兼容清单](./compatibility.json)、[源码安装与 Alpha 验证](./docs/maintenance-workflow.md)、[已验证范围与平台限制](./docs/maintenance-2026-09-06/release/README.md)。\n\n接着直接用自然语言拉团队：\n\n> 使用 AgentTeams 审查 v0.5.3 之后的提交，分别从性能、安全和产品角度分工，最后输出一份汇总报告。\n\n队长会话从第一轮起保留精简的固定核心协议和原有 14 个业务工具，直接调用，无需额外的加载工具或激活调用。已配置模板的精简目录固定保留。创建、批准、继续或结束团队都不会改写系统提示词和工具 schema，会话压缩或代码模式丢弃工具结果也不会丢失核心规则。成员保留四个团队工具、固定成员说明及普通编程/研究工具。Web 批准后会通知并唤醒队长，后续成员报告会再次唤醒它，无需忙轮询。详见[固定协议与 benchmark 标准](./docs/progressive-loading.md)。\n\n## 在工作区查看团队\n\n从当前聊天标题栏或回复下方的团队卡片点击 **查看团队**，在原生「团队协作」标签页中查看成员分工、任务依赖和执行进度。入口跟随所属聊天，不放在通用工作区开始页。\n\n页面直接呈现团队和任务内容；宽屏并排展示，窄分栏自动堆叠。点击任务可定位负责成员，成员图标可打开对应会话。关闭标签页不会停止团队；回到所属聊天可以再次打开。已完成团队保留归档，旧宿主继续使用活动面板。\n\n## 工作方式\n\n1. 当前会话创建团队并成为队长。\n2. 队长按角色添加由可续聊子 Agent 驱动的成员。\n3. 目标被拆成有负责人和显式依赖的任务。\n4. 共享调度器依据真实 `running / idle / ready` 状态，为每个空闲成员原子领取一项就绪任务并唤醒它；驻留成员被中断时会停驻当前 attempt，可通过直接消息继续而不丢 capability；只有冷进程重启后的遗留任务才会生成新 attempt 恢复。\n5. 成员携带当前 `attempt_id` 更新任务；转派或队长接管会先撤销旧 attempt、等待原成员安静，再启动新 attempt。\n6. 队长汇总结果，随后归档完整团队记录。\n\n团队状态保存在 `<workspace>/.agent-teams/`；Web 面板读取这份磁盘真相，并与实时子 Agent 活动合并展示。\n\n成员创建默认零交互：成员沿用队长当前 LLM 路由时会快照该 provider、model 与思考强度；用户要求改用其他路由时，则快照目标模型的默认强度，成员后续续跑仍使用最终解析出的快照。只有当用户明确提出异构分工（例如“后端用 provider A/model X，前端用 provider B/model Y”）时，队长才会把对应的 `provider` + `model` 传给该成员；不会逐个弹出模型或思考强度选择。\n\n## Slash 命令\n\n无需再说“用 AgentTeams”。插件注册了封闭命名空间的 `/agent-teams` 宿主命令，Web GUI 的 slash 菜单会显示 `agent-teams` 占位项与输入提示：选中它（或直接输入命令）、描述目标、回车即可。\n\n```\n/agent-teams       "content": "/** Stable, agent-scoped presentation. Business authority stays in the tools. */\nimport { onAgentReady } from './harness-compat.ts'\nimport type { Context } from '@deepseek-ai/cordis'\nimport type { Agent } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent'\nimport { readdirSync } from 'node:fs'\nimport { join } from 'node:path'\nimport { readTeamSync, readRetiredMemberIdsSync } from './state.ts'\nimport { leadIdentityOf, teamLeadMatch } from './lineage.ts'\nimport type { TeamState } from './types.ts'\nimport { MEMBER_TOOL_NAMES, TEAM_TOOL_NAMES } from './tool-names.ts'\n\nexport const TEAM_ACTIVATION_PROMPT = 'AgentTeams (Agent Teams) provides multi-agent team collaboration. Apply these rules when the user requests it (including /agent-teams) or when continuing an existing team. Mentioning, quoting, discussing, or declining AgentTeams alone is not a request to start work.'\nexport const TEAM_MEMBER_PROMPT = 'You are an AgentTeams member. Follow your assigned member persona and task contract. Use agent_teams_claim_task, agent_teams_update_task, agent_teams_send_message and agent_teams_status for your own work. Include the current attempt_id in updates; report completion or failure to the captain. Do not create, approve, edit or resume a team. If your durable membership is unavailable, report that to the parent instead of creating a replacement.'\n\ninterface Exposure {\n  member: boolean\n  dispose: () => void\n}\n\ninterface CapabilityConfig {\n  stateDir: string\n  isPendingMember: (agent: Agent) => boolean\n  captainPrompt: () => string\n  order?: number\n}\n\nfunction stateRoot(agent: Agent, config: CapabilityConfig): string {\n  return join(agent.session.header.cwd ?? process.cwd(), config.stateDir)\n}\n\n/** Synchronous startup/HMR hydration must finish before the first assembly. */\nfunction currentTeam(ctx: Context, agent: Agent, config: CapabilityConfig): TeamState | undefined {\n  const lead = leadIdentityOf(ctx, agent.session)\n  const root = stateRoot(agent, config)\n  let entries\n  try { entries = readdirSync(root, { withFileTypes: true }) } catch (error) {\n    if ((error as NodeJS.ErrnoException).code === 'ENOENT') return undefined\n    throw error\n  }\n  let found: TeamState | undefined\n  for (const entry of entries) {\n    if (!entry.isDirectory() || entry.name === 'archive') continue\n    const team = readTeamSync(root, entry.name)\n    if (team === undefined || (!teamLeadMatch(team, lead)\n      && !team.members.some(member => member.id === agent.id))) continue\n    if (found !== undefined) throw new Error('ambiguous AgentTeams membership')\n    found = team\n  }\n  return found\n}\n\n/** Call once, after all business definitions have registered. Never per member. */\nexport function installTeamCapabilities(ctx: Context, config: CapabilityConfig): void {\n  const states = new WeakMap<Agent, Exposure>()\n  const active = new Set<Exposure>()\n  let mounted = true\n  // Snapshot policy once: profiles, team state, and tool results must never\n  // rewrite this prefix or control whether core instructions are available.\n  const captainPrompt = `${TEAM_ACTIVATION_PROMPT}\\n\\n${config.captainPrompt()}`\n\n  function attach(agent: Agent): Exposure {\n    const prior = states.get(agent)\n    if (prior !== undefined) return prior\n    if (!mounted) throw new Error('AgentTeams capability provider is disposed')\n    // Determine a member's role before its first request and retain it for the\n    // lifetime of this scope. Both emit\n * synchronous agent/session-start with the explicit Agent. Their public\n * sendMessage instead steers a running Agent and must never carry team jobs.\n */\nimport type { Context } from '@deepseek-ai/cordis'\nimport type { Agent, AgentOptions } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent'\nimport type { ContentBlock, MessageId, MessageSource, StreamChunk } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm'\nimport { createUserMessage } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm'\nimport * as dshSession from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-session'\nimport type { Session, SessionEvent, SessionId } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-session'\nimport { SubagentError } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent'\nimport { BUILTIN_DENY_TOOLS, resolveMemberToolFilter, type MemberToolFilter } from './tool-policies.ts'\n\n/**\n * Exact protocol exported by dsh-subagent/internal in Alpha.5 and rc.1.\n * That subpath does not exist in Alpha.2, so importing it statically prevents\n * the plugin from loading there. */\nconst hostPromptQueue = Symbol.for('dsh.subagent.queuePrompt')\n// 0.1.5 keeps queueHostSubagentPrompt but replaces its symbol with this\n// delivery-mode-aware implementation (packages/subagent/subagent/src/internal.ts).\nconst hostPromptDeliver = Symbol.for('dsh.subagent.deliverPrompt')\ntype Setup = (childCtx: Context, child: Agent) => () => void\ntype LegacySetup = (childCtx: Context & { agent?: Agent }) => () => void\ntype Followup = (parent: Agent, childId: SessionId, content: ContentBlock[], options: {\n  source: MessageSource; signal: AbortSignal\n}) => SessionId, content: ContentBlock[], source: MessageSource, signal: AbortSignal, delivery: 'queue' | 'steer') => Promise<MessageId>\ntype Send = (sender: Agent, targetId: SessionId, content: ContentBlock[], options: { signal: AbortSignal }) => Promise<MessageId>\ninterface RuntimeBoundary {\n  followup?: Followup\n  registerContinuableSetup?: (setup: LegacySetup) => () => void\n  sendMessage?: Send\n  [hostPromptQueue]?: Queue\n  [hostPromptDeliver]?: Deliver\n}\n\n/** Version-independent creation contract; legacy-only options stay at this seam. */\nexport interface MemberStartSpec {\n  provider: string\n  label: string\n  request: {\n    parent: Agent\n    prompt: ContentBlock[]\n    agentOptions?: AgentOptions\n    persona?: string\n    toolFilter?: MemberToolFilter\n  }\n  signal: AbortSignal\n}\ninterface CreationBoundary {\n  start?: (name: string, request: MemberStartSpec['request']) => Promise<unknown>\n  startContinuable?: (spec: MemberStartSpec) => Promise<{ childId: SessionId }>\n  startActivation?: (spec: MemberStartSpec & { delivery: 'parent' }) => Promise<{\n    childId: SessionId\n    result: Promise<unknown>\n  }>\n}\nexport function usesManagedActivations(runtime: Context['subagents']): boolean {\n  return typeof (runtime as unknown as CreationBoundary).startActivation === 'function'\n}\n\nexport async function startMember(runtime: Context['subagents'], spec: MemberStartSpec): Promise<{ childId: SessionId }> {\n  const host = runtime as unknown as CreationBoundary\n  if (typeof host.startActivation === 'function') {\n    const { persona: _persona, toolFilter: _filter, ...request } = spec.request\n    const activation = await host.startActivation.call(runtime, { ...spec, request, delivery: 'parent' })\n    // Preserve native settlement as the missing-report/error fallback on both\n    // fresh and resumed activations. mailbox.ts deduplicates successful reports.\n    void activation.result.catch(() => undefined)\n    return activation\n  }\n  if (typeof host.startContinuable !== 'function') return unsupported('missing member creation API')\n  return host.startContinuable.call(runtime, spec)\n}\n\n/** Wrap every available creation API, restoring only this plugin's own methods. */\nexport function guardSubagentCreation(ctx: Context, check: (parent: Agent) => void): void {\n  const runtime = ctx.subagents as unknown as CreationBoundary\n  ctx.effect(() => {\n    const disposers: (() => void)[] = []\n    for (const key of ['start', 'startContinuable', 'startActivation'] as const) {\n      const original = runtime[key]\n      if (typeof original !== 'function') continue\n      const descriptor = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(runtime, key)\n      const guarded = async (...args: unknown[]): Promise<unknown> => {\n        const request = key === 'start' ? args[1] : (args[0] as MemberStartSpec).request\n        check((request as MemberStartSpec['request']).parent)\n        return Reflect.apply(original, ctx.subagents, args)\n      }\n      Object.defineProperty(runtime, key, { value: guarded, writable: true, configurable: true })\n      disposers.push(() => {\n        if (Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(runtime, key)?.value !== guarded) return\n        if (descriptor === undefined) Reflect.deleteProperty(runtime, key)\n        else Object.defineProperty(runtime, key, descriptor)\n      })\n    }\n    return () => { for (const dispose of disposers) dispose() }\n  }, 'agent-teams: member delegation budget')\n}\n\nfunction boundary(runtime: Context['subagents']): RuntimeBoundary {\n  return runtime as unknown as RuntimeBoundary\n}\n\nfunction unsupported(detail: string): never {\n  throw new Error(`agent-teams: unsupported Harness subagent contract (${detail}); use an explicitly tested Harness version and a coherent dependency installation`)\n}\n\ndeclare module '@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm' {\n  interface MessageSourceMap {\n    'agent-teams': { readonly kind: 'agent-teams' }\n  }\n}\n\n/** Package identity a released plugin-wrapper source names on older hosts. */\nexport const AGENT_TEAMS_PLUGIN_NAME = '@nanmicoder/dsh-agent-teams'\n\n/**\n * First stored format generation whose migration edges admit producer-owned\n * source kinds. The released v2→v3 payload audit validates every message source\n * against a closed list of released kinds, so a stored format older than this\n * must carry a released source or the whole session becomes unreadable once a\n * newer host opens it (#160).\n */\nexport const RELEASED_SOURCE_VOCABULARY_VERSION = 3\n\n/** Source kinds this plugin mints on a host whose stored format admits them. */\nexport type AgentTeamsSource =\n  | { readonly kind: 'agent-teams' }\n  | { readonly kind: 'agent-teams-command'; readonly goal?: string; readonly profile?: string }\n\n/** Anything that exposes the stored format generation on its live session header. */\nexport interface SessionFormatBearer {\n  readonly session?: { readonly header?: { readonly version?: unknown } } | undefined\n}\n\n/**\n * Stored format generation observed on a live session, when the host exposes it.\n *\n * The module constant is only a fallback: a plugin can resolve a *nested*\n * `@deepseek-ai/dsh-session` copy that belongs to a different host generation\n * than the process loading it (a profile whose lockfile pins the DSH package\n * line, a Desktop shell with an embedded core, a duplicated store). That copy\n * then reports the wrong generation — 0 on a v4 host — which selects the\n * retired `plugin` wrapper and makes every durable AgentTeams message fail the\n * host's own admission check (#236). The live session header belongs to the\n * host that persists the message, so it outranks the resolved module.\n */\nexport function observedSessionFormatVersion(subject?: SessionFormatBearer): number | undefined {\n  const version = subject?.session?.header?.version\n  return typeof version === 'number' && Number.isSafeInteger(version) && version >= 0 ? version : undefined\n}\n\n/**\n * Stored session format generation of the running host; 0 when neither the live\n * session nor the resolved module exposes one.\n * @param observed - a live session observation; preferred over the module constant.\n */\nexport function hostSessionFormatVersion(observed?: number): number {\n  if (typeof observed === 'number' && Number.isSafeInteger(observed) && observed >= 0) return observed\n  const version = (dshSession as unknown as { SESSION_FORMAT_VERSION?: number }).SESSION_FORMAT_VERSION\n  return typeof version === 'number' && Number.isSafeInteger(version) && version >= 0 ? version : 0\n}\n\n/**\n * Source for one AgentTeams-authored message on the running host.\n *\n * Current hosts mint producer-owned kinds: the Harness documents message\n * sources as a merge-extensible vocabulary without a catch-all, so this plugin\n * declares its own. Hosts that still store a pre-v3 generation are a different\n * contract — their released v2→v3 migration rejects any source outside the\n * released vocabulary, which is exactly how a plugin kind written on an older\n * supported host poisons its session log for every later host. Never trust the resolved module alone: on a\n * host whose profile pins another DSH line it reports a retired generation and\n * the v4 writer rejects the wrapper (#236).\n * @returns a source accepted by the running host and by its migration chain.\n */\nexport function agentTeamsSource(modern: AgentTeamsSource, observed?: number): MessageSource {\n  if (hostSessionFormatVersion(observed) >= RELEASED_SOURCE_VOCABULARY_VERSION) return modern\n  // Released-format hosts persist plugin-authored messages as this wrapper; the\n  // current vocabulary retired it, so the cast stays confined to this branch\n  // and `modern` is the only shape a current host ever sees.\n  return { kind: 'plugin', plugin: AGENT_TEAMS_PLUGIN_NAME } as unknown as MessageSource\n}\n\n/**\n * 0.1.6 moved startup admission to serial agent/created. 0)\n}\n\n/** Legacy hosts log each chunk separately; current hosts embed the committed stream. */\nexport function outputLimitTurn(event: SessionEvent): number | undefined {\n  const record = event as SessionEvent | {\n    type: 'assistant/chunk'\n    data: { turn: number; chunk: StreamChunk }\n  }\n  if (record.type === 'assistant/chunk') {\n    const { chunk, turn } = record.data\n    return chunk.type === 'finish' && chunk.reason.kind === 'max-tokens' ? turn : undefined\n  }\n  if (record.type === 'assistant/message' && record.data.stream?.some(item =>\n    item.type === 'chunk' && item.chunk.type === 'finish' && item.chunk.reason.kind === 'max-tokens')) {\n    return record.data.turn\n  }\n}\n\n/** Install before the first request, including cold resume, with HMR cleanup. */\nexport function installContinuableMemberSetup(ctx: Context, setup: Setup): void {\n  const runtime = boundary(ctx.subagents)\n  if (typeof runtime.registerContinuableSetup === 'function') {\n    // Upstream owns this registration with this.ctx.effect. Cordis resolves\n    // that ctx to the accessing plugin, so its disposal revokes installations\n    // even while the subagents service and child Agents remain live.\n    runtime.registerContinuableSetup.call(ctx.subagents, (childCtx) => {\n      if (childCtx.agent === undefined) return unsupported('legacy setup lacks child Agent')\n      return setup(childCtx, childCtx.agent)\n    })\n    return\n  }\n  if ((typeof runtime[hostPromptQueue] !== 'function' && typeof runtime[hostPromptDeliver] !== 'function') || typeof runtime.sendMessage !== 'function') {\n    return unsupported('missing continuable setup and modern host queue')\n  }\n  const installed = new WeakSet<Agent>()\n  const active = new Set<() => void>()\n  ctx.effect(() => {\n    const attach = (agent: Agent, vetoable: boolean): void => {\n      if (installed.has(agent)) return\n      // Deliberately synchronous: awaiting here loses the first-request race.\n      let teardown: () => void\n      try {\n        teardown = setup(agent.ctx, agent)\n      } catch (error: unknown) {\n        if (vetoable) throw error\n        // session-start is a notification: Harness logs a thrown listener and\n        // still admits the first prompt. Reject request assembly explicitly so\n        // a malformed saved route cannot silently execute on a default model.\n        const failure = new Error(`agent-teams: member initialization failed: ${String(error)}`, { cause: error })\n        ctx.logger.warn(failure.message)\n        teardown = agent.ctx.on('agent/request', () => { throw failure })\n      }\n      installed.add(agent)\n      let disposed = false\n      const dispose = (): void => {\n        if (disposed) return\n        disposed = true\n        active.delete(dispose)\n        installed.delete(agent)\n        teardown()\n      }\n      active.add(dispose)\n      // Listeners contributed to agent.ctx already follow its lifetime. Also\n      // release our bookkeeping and remove them if this plugin is reloaded.\n      try {\n        agent.ctx.effect(() => dispose, 'agent-teams: child compatibility setup')\n      } catch (error) {\n        dispose()\n        throw error\n      }\n    }\n    const stop = onAgentReady(ctx, attach)\n    const cleanup = (): void => {\n      stop()\n      for (const dispose of [...active]) dispose()\n    }\n    try {\n      // Reloads keep Agents alive but dispose the previous plugin's setup.\n      // Subscribe first, then hydrate the live registry; attach is idempotent.\n      for (const agent of ctx.agents.list()) attach(agent, false)\n    } catch (error) {\n      cleanup()\n      throw error\n    }\n    return cleanup\n  }, 'agent-teams: member lifecycle compatibility')\n}\n\n/** Queue a distinct host-authored turn; never substitute model-message steer. */\nexport async function queueMemberPrompt(\n  runtime: Context['subagents'], parent: Agent, childId: SessionId,\n  content: ContentBlock[], signal: AbortSignal,\n): Promise<MessageId> {\n  const host = boundary(runtime)\n  const source = agentTeamsSource({ kind: 'agent-teams' }, observedSessionFormatVersion(parent))\n  if (typeof host.followup === 'function') {\n    return host.followup.call(runtime, parent, childId, content, { source, signal })\n  }\n  const deliver = host[hostPromptDeliver]\n  if (typeof deliver === 'function') return deliver.call(runtime, parent, childId, content, source, signal, 'queue')\n  const queue = host[hostPromptQueue]\n  if (typeof queue !== 'function') return unsupported('missing host FIFO delivery')\n  return queue.call(runtime, parent, childId, content, source, signal)\n}\n\n/** Coordination joins the nearest step, including waking an idle/cold child. */\nexport async function steerMemberPrompt(\n  runtime: Context['subagents'], parent: Agent, childId: SessionId,\n  content: ContentBlock[], signal: AbortSignal, live?: Agent,\n): Promise<MessageId> {\n  const host = boundary(runtime)\n  const source = agentTeamsSource({ kind: 'agent-teams' }, observedSessionFormatVersion(live ?? parent))\n  const deliver = host[hostPromptDeliver]\n  if (typeof deliver === 'function') return deliver.call(runtime, parent, childId, content, source, signal, 'steer')\n  if (typeof host.sendMessage === 'function') return host.sendMessage.call(runtime, parent, childId, content, { signal })\n  if (typeof host.followup === 'function') {\n    if (live === undefined) return queueMemberPrompt(runtime, parent, childId,       "content": "/** Durable delivery receipts and execution-generation filtering at step admission. */\nimport type { Context } from '@deepseek-ai/cordis'\nimport { join } from 'node:path'\nimport { acknowledgeMailbox, CAPTAIN_KEY, discardMailboxMessages, findTeamByCaptain, readMailbox, readUnreadMailbox, readTeam, sanitizeKey, withTeamLock } from './state.ts'\nimport type { TeamMessage, TeamState } from './types.ts'\nimport { sessionOwnEvents } from './harness-compat.ts'\nimport { leadIdentityOfAsync, sessionLeadsTeamAsync } from './lineage.ts'\n\nconst PREFIX = 'AgentTeams inbox receipt: '\n\nexport function isCurrentMail(team: TeamState, message: TeamMessage): boolean {\n  if (message.discardedAt !== undefined) return false\n  if (message.sourceAttemptId !== undefined && !team.tasks.some(task => task.id === message.sourceTaskId\n    && task.attemptId === message.sourceAttemptId && task.assignee === message.from\n    && (message.sourceTaskStatus === undefined || !['completed', 'failed', 'cancelled'].includes(task.status) || message.sourceTaskStatus === task.status))) return false\n  if (message.attemptId === undefined) return true\n  return team.tasks.some(task => task.id === message.taskId && task.attemptId === message.attemptId\n    && task.assignee === message.to && (task.status === 'claimed' || task.status === 'in_progress'))\n}\n\n/** Include structured provenance even in the status-tool fallback presentation. */\nexport function mailboxContent(message: TeamMessage): string {\n  return (message.sourceTaskId === undefined ? ''\n    : `[Source task ${message.sourceTaskId}, attempt_id ${message.sourceAttemptId}${message.sourceTaskStatus === undefined ? '' : `, status=${message.sourceTaskStatus}`}]\\n`) + message.content\n}\n\nfunction mailboxBody(recipient: string, messages: readonly TeamMessage[]): string {\n  return messages.map(message => recipient === CAPTAIN_KEY\n      ? `AgentTeams message from member ${message.from}:\\n\\n${mailboxContent(message)}`\n      : `AgentTeams message from ${message.from}${message.attemptId === undefined ? '' : ` for task ${message.taskId}, attempt_id ${message.attemptId}`}:\\n\\n${mailboxContent(message)}`).join('\\n\\n')\n}\n\n/** Read current mail while the caller holds the lock and has verified the team. */\nexport async function readCurrentMailboxLocked(root: string, team: TeamState, recipient: string, onMalformed?: (line: number) => void): Promise<TeamMessage[]> {\n  const messages = await readUnreadMailbox(root, team.id, recipient, onMalformed)\n  const current: TeamMessage[] = []\n  const staleIds: string[] = []\n  for (const message of messages) {\n    if (isCurrentMail(team, message)) current.push(message)\n    else staleIds.push(message.id)\n  }\n  await discardMailboxMessages(root, team.id, recipient, staleIds)\n  return current\n}\n\n/** Fallback reads must enforce the same current-generation rule as live admission. */\nexport async function readCurrentMailbox(root: string, teamId: string, recipient: string, onMalformed?: (line: number) => void): Promise<TeamMessage[]> {\n  return withTeamLock(`team:${root}:${teamId}`, async () => {\n    const team = await readTeam(root, teamId)\n    return team === undefined ? [] : readCurrentMailboxLocked(root, team, recipient, onMalformed)\n  })\n}\n\nexport function mailboxPrompt(teamId: string, recipient: string, messages: readonly TeamMessage[]): string {\n  return PREFIX + JSON.stringify({ teamId, recipient, ids: messages.map(message => message.id) }) + '\\n\\n' + mailboxBody(recipient, messages)\n}\n\ninterface Receipt { teamId: string; recipient: string; ids: string[] }\nfunction parseReceipt(text: string): Receipt | undefined {\n  if (!text.startsWith(PREFIX)) return undefined\n  try {\n    const value: unknown = JSON.parse(text.slice(PREFIX.length).split('\\n')[0]!)\n    if (typeof value !== 'object' || value === null) return undefined\n    const raw = value as Record<string, unknown>\n    if (typeof raw['teamId'] !== 'string' || typeof raw['recipient'] !== 'string'\n      || !Array.isArray(raw['ids']) || !raw['ids'].every(id => typeof id === 'string')) return undefined\n    if (raw['teamId'] !== sanitizeKey(raw['teamId'])) return undefined\n    return { teamId: raw['teamId'], recipient: raw['recipient'], ids: raw['ids'] as string[] }\n  } catch { return undefined }\n}\n\n/** Only messages actually admitted to this recipient's step become read. */\nexport function installMailboxAdmission(ctx: Context, stateDir: string): void {\n  ctx.on('agent/pre-step', async (payload, next) => {\n    const decision = await next()\n    if (decision.kind !== 'enter') return decision\n    const root = join(payload.agent.session.header.cwd ?? process.cwd(), stateDir)\n    // The native runtime also wakes a parent when a background activation\n    // settles. A successfully delivered Team report already carries that\n    // result. Keep abnormal endings and missing reports as fallback signals.\n    const successfulSettlements = new Set(decision.messages.flatMap(input => {\n      const source = input.source\n      return source?.kind === 'subagent-settled'\n        && source.summary === `Background subagent ${source.senderSessionId} finished and will do no further work unless you send it more.`\n        ? [source.senderSessionId as string] : []\n    }))\n    const redundantSettlements = new Set<string>()\n    if (successfulSettlements.size > 0) {\n      // Narrow containment: only AgentTeams state reads degrade silently.\n      try {\n        const owned = await findTeamByCaptain(root, payload.agent.id, await leadIdentityOfAsync(ctx, payload.agent.session))\n        if (owned !== undefined) await withTeamLock(`team:${root}:${owned.id}`, async () => {\n          const team = await readTeam(root, owned.id)\n          if (team === undefined || !(await sessionLeadsTeamAsync(ctx, team, payload.agent.id)) || team.halted) return\n          const reports = await readMailbox(root, team.id, CAPTAIN_KEY)\n          for (const member of team.members) {\n            if (!successfulSettlements.has(member.id) || member.status === 'removed' || member.stopping) continue\n            const tasks = team.tasks.filter(task => task.assignee === member.name)\n            if (tasks.some(task => task.status === 'claimed' || task.status === 'in_progress')) continue\n            const latest = tasks.filter(task => (task.attempt ?? 0) > 0 || task.status === 'completed').sort((a, b) => b.updatedAt - a.updatedAt)[0]\n            if (latest?.status === 'completed' && reports.some(report => report.from === member.name && report.ts >= latest.updatedAt\n              && report.discardedAt === undefined && (report.deliveredAt !== undefined || report.readAt !== undefined))) {\n              redundantSettlements.add(member.id)\n            }\n          }\n        })\n      } catch (error: unknown) {\n        // A corrupt AgentTeams state file (e.g. an invalid team.json) must never\n        // hold the host's step admission hostage: degrade to plain admission.\n        ctx.logger?.warn(`agent-teams: mailbox admission degraded to plain pass-through for agent ${payload.agent.id}: could not read team state under ${root} (a team.json may be corrupt or unreadable): ${String(error)}`)\n        return decision\n      }\n    }\n    const batches = new Map<string, { receipt: Receipt; ids: Set<string>; current: Map<string, TeamMessage>; failed?: boolean }>()\n    const inputs = decision.messages.map(input => {\n      // Alpha.5/0.1.2-rc.1 public steering prepends a native sender block.\n      // The host-authored receipt remains a separate text block after it.\n      const receipt = input.content.flatMap(block => block.type === 'text' ? [parseReceipt(block.text)] : []).find(value => value !== undefined)\n      if (receipt === undefined) return { input }\n      const key = JSON.stringify([receipt.teamId, receipt.recipient])\n      let batch = batches.get(key)\n      if (batch === undefined) { batch = { receipt, ids: new Set(), current: new Map() }; batches.set(key, batch) }\n      for (const id of receipt.ids) batch.ids.add(id)\n      return { input, receipt, batch }\n    })\n    // One read/acknowledgement per recipient per step, even for a large burst.\n    for (const batch of batches.values()) {\n      const { receipt } = batch\n      try {\n        await withTeamLock(`team:${root}:${receipt.teamId}`, async () => {\n          const team = await readTeam(root, receipt.teamId)\n          if (team === undefined) return\n          // Captain mail is admitted for any lead session of the team: after a\n          // fork the human reads it in the fork while members still address the\n          // recorded captain. Acknowledging marks it read for both.\n          const isCaptainRecipient = receipt.recipient === CAPTAIN_KEY\n            && await sessionLeadsTeamAsync(ctx, team, payload.agent.id)\n          const recipientId = receipt.recipient === CAPTAIN_KEY ? team.captainSessionId\n            : team.members.find(member => member.name === receipt.recipient && member.status !== 'removed' && member.stopping !== true)?.id\n          if (!isCaptainRecipient && recipientId !== payload.agent.id) return\n          const selected = (await readMailbox(root, team.id, receipt.recipient)).filter(message => batch.ids.has(message.id))\n          const current = selected.filter(message => message.readAt === undefined && isCurrentMail(team, message))\n          await discardMailboxMessages(root, team.id, receipt.recipient, selected.filter(message => !isCurrentMail(team, message)).map(message => message.id))\n          await acknowledgeMailbox(root, team.id, receipt.recipient, current.map(message => message.id))\n          batch.current = new Map(current.map(message => [message.id, message]))\n        })\n      } catch (error: unknown) {\n        // Narrow containment, per team: the messages of this batch are not\n        // acked (the teamId/recipient above identify the unread mail), but the\n        // receipt inputs still pass through untouched instead of holding the\n        // host's step admission hostage.\n        batch.failed = true\n        ctx.logger?.warn(`agent-teams: mailbox admission degraded to plain pass-through for agent ${payload.agent.id}: could not read team \"${receipt.teamId}\" (state under ${root} may be corrupt or unreadable, recipient ${receipt.recipient} mail left unacked): ${String(error)}`)\n      }\n    }\n    const admitted = []\n    for (const { input, receipt, batch } of inputs) {\n      if (input.source?.kind === 'subagent-settled' && redundantSettlements.has(input.source.senderSessionId)\n        && input.source.summary === `Background subagent ${input.source.senderSessionId} finished and will do no further work unless you send it more.`) continue\n      if (receipt === undefined || batch === undefined || batch.failed === true) { admitted.push(input); continue }\n      const messages = []\n      for (const id of receipt.ids) {\n        const message = batch.current.get(id)\n        if (message === undefined) continue\n        batch.current.delete(id)\n        messages.push(message)\n      }\n      if (messages.length > 0) admitted.push({ ...input, content: [{ type: 'text' as const, text: mailboxBody(receipt.recipient, messages) }] })\n    }\n    // Reject only a new turn whose sole trigger was obsolete mail. During an\n    // existing turn, a status tool may have consumed this same mail already;\n    // dropping its duplicate must not block the pending tool-result response.\n    if (decision.messages.length > 0 && admitted.length === 0) {\n      const events = sessionOwnEvents(payload.agent.session)\n      let continuing = false\n      for (let i = events.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {\n        const event = events[i]!\n        if (event.type === 'step/start' && event.data.turn === payload.turn) { continuing = true; break }\n        if (event.type === 'turn/start') break\n      }\n      if (!continuing) return { kind: 'reject' }\n    }\n    return { ...decision, messages: admitted }\n  })\n}\n"

      "content": "/**\n * Member subagent lifecycle: spawn a continuable child per member, deliver\n * task turns and step-boundary messages, and observe its activity.\n *\n * Members are durable continuable subagents of the captain, so a member keeps\n * its conversation across turns and across harness restarts: the captain\n * queues its next turn through {@link deliverToMember}, it works through its turn\n * (updating team state through the `agent_teams_*` tools), and becomes idle\n * again. Its final assistant message is not readable programmatically, so the\n * member persists its report into the captain's mailbox and the task records,\n * which the captain reads through `agent_teams_status`.\n * @module dsh-agent-teams/members\n */\n\nimport type { Context } from '@deepseek-ai/cordis'\nimport { installModelSelection, type Agent, type ModelSelection } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent'\n// Declaration merge only: makes ctx.subagents visible.\nimport { foldSubagentDescriptor } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent'\nimport { createUserMessage, LlmError, ReasoningEffortId } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm'\nimport type { Session, SessionId } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-session'\nimport { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto'\nimport { join } from 'node:path'\nimport { agentTeamsSource, observedSessionFormatVersion, outputLimitTurn, type SessionFormatBearer, guardSubagentCreation, startMember, usesManagedActivations, guardSubagentDelivery, installContinuableMemberSetup, memberToolFilter, queueMemberPrompt, restrictableToolNames, startMemberWithLenientFilter, steerMemberPrompt, sessionOwnEvents } from './harness-compat.ts'\nimport { markMailboxDelivered, appendMailbox, CAPTAIN_KEY, createMessage, readRetiredMemberIds, readTeamSync, readTeam, releaseMailboxDelivery, withTeamLock, writeTeam } from './state.ts'\nimport { mailboxPrompt } from './mailbox.ts'\nimport { nearestLiveLead } from './lineage.ts'\nimport { appendTeamEvent, captainSessionOf } from './events.ts'\nimport type { MemberToolFilter } from './tool-policies.ts'\nimport { TERMINAL_TASK_STATUSES, type TeamMember, type TeamState, type TeamTask } from './types.ts'\n\n/** Persona snapshot of a profile protocol; the full text lives on team.json. */\nexport const PERSONA_PROTOCOL_MAX_CHARS = 400\n\n/**\n * Restore the SessionId brand on a value that round-tripped through the\n * durable team file. The brand is erased by JSON serialization; the value\n * originated from `startContinuable`/`agent.id`, so this cast is the boundary\n * restoration, not a new assertion.\n */\nfunction brandedSessionId(value: string): SessionId {\n  return value as SessionId\n}\n\n/** Runtime knobs for member spawning, resolved from plugin config. */\nexport interface MemberRuntimeConfig {\n  /** Registered `ctx.subagents` provider name (must support continuable + persona). */\n  provider: string\n  /** Child delegation depth cap (0 forbids delegation entirely). */\n  maxDepth?: number\n  /** Plugin-wide execution prompt. */\n  executionPrompt?: string\n  /** Plugin-wide fallback route. */\n  fallback?: { provider: string; model: string }\n}\n\n/** Durable provider/model/reasoning snapshot for one member. */\nexport interface MemberLlmSelection {\n  /** Registered LLM provider route. */\n  provider: string\n  /** Provider-owned model id. */\n  model: string\n  /** Adapter-owned reasoning effort, absent when the target has no explicit/default effort. */\n  reasoningEffort?: string\n  /** Configured second-choice route. */\n  fallback?: { provider: string; model: string }\n}\n\n/** Optional member-level route requested by the captain. */\nexport interface MemberLlmSelectionRequest {\n  /** Explicit LLM provider route; requires an explicit model. */\n  provider?: string\n  /** Explicit model id; otherwise the plugin default or captain model is used. */\n  model?: string\n  /** Plugin-level member model default. */\n  defaultModel?: string\n  /** Configured member LLM provider, paired with `defaultModel` (issue #189). */\n  defaultProvider?: string\n  /** Explicit reasoning effort; \"default\" selects the target model's default effort. */\n  reasoningEffort?: string\n  /** Configured fallback route. */\n  fallback?: { provider: string; model: string }\n}\n\n/** A composed member route plus where each half came from. */\nexport interface MemberRouteResolution {\n  readonly provider: { readonly value: string;       "content": "import { createHash } from 'node:crypto'\nimport type { IncomingMessage, ServerResponse } from 'node:http'\nimport type { HostConnectionService } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-connection'\n\n/** Public WebServer route surface used by the plugin. */\nexport interface WebRouteHost {\n  register(route: {\n    kind: 'exact' | 'prefix'\n    path: string\n    handler: (req: IncomingMessage, res: ServerResponse) => void | Promise<void>\n  }): () => void\n}\n\nexport type BrowserRequestGate = Pick<HostConnectionService, 'requestRejection'>\n\nexport class RequestBodyError extends Error {\n  constructor(message: string, readonly status: 400 | 413) {\n    super(message)\n  }\n}\n\n/** Bound memory while draining oversized requests so the route can return 413. */\nexport async function readJsonRequest(req: IncomingMessage, maxBytes = 1_000_000): Promise<Record<string, unknown>> {\n  const raw = await new Promise<string>((resolve, reject) => {\n    let size = 0\n    let settled = false\n    const chunks: Buffer[] = []\n    const finish = (error?: Error): void => {\n      if (settled) return\n      settled = true\n      req.off('data', onData)\n      req.off('end', onEnd)\n      req.off('aborted', onAborted)\n      req.off('error', onError)\n      if (error) {\n        chunks.length = 0\n        // IncomingMessage may still receive data; discard it without buffering.\n        req.once('error', () => {})\n        req.resume()\n        reject(error)\n      } else {\n        resolve(Buffer.concat(chunks).toString('utf8'))\n      }\n    }\n    const onData = (chunk: Buffer | string): void => {\n      const part = Buffer.isBuffer(chunk) ? chunk : Buffer.from(chunk)\n      size += part.length\n      if (size > maxBytes) finish(new RequestBodyError('request body is too large', 413))\n      else chunks.push(part)\n    }\n    const onEnd = (): void => finish()\n    const onAborted = (): void => finish(new RequestBodyError('request body was aborted', 400))\n    const onError = (): void => finish(new RequestBodyError('invalid request body', 400))\n    req.on('data', onData)\n    req.once('end', onEnd)\n    req.once('aborted', onAborted)\n    req.once('error', onError)\n  })\n  let value: unknown\n  try {\n    value = raw.trim() === '' ? {} : JSON.parse(raw)\n  } catch {\n    throw new RequestBodyError('invalid JSON', 400)\n  }\n  if (typeof value !== 'object' || value === null || Array.isArray(value)) {\n    throw new RequestBodyError('body must be an object', 400)\n  }\n  return value as Record<string, unknown>\n}\n\nfunction matchesEntityTagList(header: string | undefined, tag: string): boolean {\n  if (header === undefined) return false\n  if (header.trim() === '*') return true\n  // A comma can be part of the quoted opaque tag. Consume whole list entries\n  // and compare their quoted values, accepting either weak or strong spelling.\n  const entry = /[ \\t]*(?:(?:W\\/)?(\"[\\x21\\x23-\\x7e\\x80-\\xff]*\"))?[ \\t]*(?:,|$)/y\n  let matched = false\n  while (entry.lastIndex < header.length) {\n    const parsed = entry.exec(header)\n    if (parsed === null) return false\n    matched ||= parsed[1] === tag\n  }\n  return matched\n}\n\n/** Revalidate a current JSON representation across both identity and gzip delivery. */\nexport function writeJsonWithEtag(req: IncomingMessage, res: ServerResponse, body: string): void {\n  const tag = `\"${createHash('sha256').update(body).digest('base64url')}\"`\n  const headers = { 'cache-control': 'no-store', etag: `W/${tag}` }\n  if ((req.method === 'GET' || req.method === 'HEAD')\n    && matchesEntityTagList(req.headers['if-none-match'], tag)) {\n    res.writeHead(304, headers)\n    res.end()\n    return\n  }\n  res.writeHead(200, { ...headers, 'content-type': 'application/json; charset=utf-8' })\n  res.end(body)\n}\n\n/** Raw WebServer routes do not inherit Connection's authentication fence. */\nexport function authenticatedWebRoutes(\n  server: WebRouteHost,\n  connection: () => BrowserRequestGate | undefined,\n): WebRouteHost {\n  return {\n    register(route) {\n      return server.register({\n        ...route,\n        async handler(req, res) {\n          const gate = connection()\n          // Missing/disposing Connection is an assembly failure, never an\n          // invitation to expose workspace state or accept plan mutations.\n          const rejection = gate === undefined ? 503 : gate.requestRejection(req)\n          if (rejection !== undefined) {\n            res.writeHead(rejection, {\n              'content-type': 'application/json; charset=utf-8',\n              'cache-control': 'no-store',\n            })\n            res.end(JSON.stringify({ error: rejection === 503 ?       "content": "/** Bounded, lifecycle-owned execution of current-byte audits off the host thread. */\nimport type { Context } from '@deepseek-ai/cordis'\nimport { createHash } from 'node:crypto'\nimport { join, resolve } from 'node:path'\nimport { Worker } from 'node:worker_threads'\nimport { deliveryArtifactPaths, deliveryScopePatterns, type DeliveryAudit } from './quality-gates.ts'\nimport { readTeam } from './state.ts'\nimport type { TeamState } from './types.ts'\n\ninterface AuditJob {\n  id: number\n  key: string\n  workspace: string\n  stateRoot: string\n  team: TeamState\n  source: string\n  promise: Promise<DeliveryAudit>\n  complete: (audit: DeliveryAudit) => void\n}\n\n/** Execution limits; callers cannot turn these into a successful partial audit. */\nexport interface WorkspaceAuditOptions {\n  workerUrl?: URL\n  timeoutMs?: number\n  maxPending?: number\n}\n\nfunction incomplete(reason: string): DeliveryAudit {\n  return { artifacts: [], expandedScope: [], gaps: [{ pattern: '(workspace audit)', reason }] }\n}\n\nfunction isAudit(value: unknown): value is DeliveryAudit {\n  if (typeof value !== 'object' || value === null) return false\n  const audit = value as DeliveryAudit\n  return Array.isArray(audit.artifacts)\n    && audit.artifacts.every(item => typeof item?.path === 'string' && typeof item.present === 'boolean'\n      && (item.present !== true || (typeof item.sha256 === 'string' && /^[a-f0-9]{64}$/.test(item.sha256))))\n    && Array.isArray(audit.expandedScope)\n    && audit.expandedScope.every(item => typeof item?.path === 'string' && typeof item.present === 'boolean')\n    && (audit.gaps === undefined || (Array.isArray(audit.gaps)\n      && audit.gaps.every(gap => typeof gap?.pattern === 'string' && typeof gap.reason === 'string')))\n}\n\n/**\n * One lazy, reusable worker per plugin owner. Identical requests may share a\n * queued audit until it is dispatched. Every later request needs a read that\n * starts after it arrives.\n */\nexport class WorkspaceAuditService {\n  private worker: Worker | undefined\n  private active: AuditJob | undefined\n  private timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined\n  private idleTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined\n  private readonly jobs = new Set<AuditJob>()\n  private readonly queue: AuditJob[] = []\n  private sequence = 0\n  private closed = false\n\n  constructor(private readonly options: WorkspaceAuditOptions = {}) {}\n\n  audit(workspace: string, team: TeamState, stateRoot = join(workspace, '.agent-teams')): Promise<DeliveryAudit> {\n    if (this.closed) return Promise.resolve(incomplete('workspace audit service was disposed; retry after reload'))\n    if (deliveryArtifactPaths(team).length === 0 && deliveryScopePatterns(team).length === 0) {\n      return Promise.resolve({ artifacts: [], expandedScope: [] })\n    }\n    const source = JSON.stringify(team)\n    const key = `${resolve(workspace)}\\0${resolve(stateRoot)}\\0${team.id}\\0${createHash('sha256').update(source).digest('hex')}`\n    const existing = this.queue.find(job => job.key === key)\n    if (existing !== undefined) return existing.promise\n    if (this.jobs.size >= (this.options.maxPending ?? 16)) {\n      return Promise.resolve(incomplete('workspace audit queue is full; retry instead of treating unaudited bytes as verified'))\n    }\n    let complete!: AuditJob['complete']\n    const promise = new Promise<DeliveryAudit>(done => { complete = done })\n    const job: AuditJob = { id: ++this.sequence, key, workspace, stateRoot, source, team: JSON.parse(source) as TeamState, promise, complete }\n    this.jobs.add(job)\n    this.queue.push(job)\n    this.pump()\n    return promise\n  }\n\n  private pump(): void {\n    if (this.closed || this.active !== undefined || this.queue.length === 0) return\n    clearTimeout(this.idleTimer)\n    this.idleTimer = undefined\n    const job = this.queue.shift() as AuditJob\n    this.active = job\n    try {\n      if (this.worker === undefined) {\n        const worker = new Worker(this.options.workerUrl ?? new URL('./workspace-audit-worker.js', import.meta.url))\n        this.worker = worker\n        worker.on('message', (message: unknown) => {\n          if (this.worker !== worker) return\n          const reply = message as { id?: number; audit?: unknown; error?: unknown } | undefined\n          if (reply === null || typeof reply !== 'object' || reply.id !== this.active?.id) {\n            this.failWorker('workspace audit worker returned an invalid response')\n            return\n          }\n          const current = this.active as AuditJob\n          this.active = undefined\n          clearTimeout(this.timer)\n          this.timer = undefined\n          worker.unref()\n          const audit = isAudit(reply.audit)\n            ? reply.audit\n            : incomplete(typeof reply.error === 'string' ? `workspace audit failed: ${reply.error}` : 'workspace audit worker returned incomplete evidence')\n          void this.finish(current, audit)\n          this.pump()\n          if (this.active === undefined) {\n            this.idleTimer = setTimeout(() => {\n              if (this.worker === worker && this.active === undefined) {\n                this.worker = undefined\n                void worker.terminate()\n              }\n            }, 10_000)\n            this.idleTimer.unref()\n          }\n        })\n        worker.on('error', error => { if (this.worker === worker) this.failWorker(`workspace audit worker failed: ${error.message}`) })\n        worker.on('exit', code => { if (this.worker === worker) this.failWorker(`workspace audit worker exited (${code}) before completing its evidence`) })\n      }\n      this.worker.ref()\n      this.timer = setTimeout(() => this.failWorker('workspace audit timed out; current bytes could not be verified'), this.options.timeoutMs ?? 120_000)\n      this.worker.postMessage({ id: job.id, workspace: job.workspace, team: job.team })\n    } catch (error) {\n      this.failWorker(`workspace audit could not start: ${String(error)}`)\n    }\n  }\n\n  private async finish(job: AuditJob, audit: DeliveryAudit): Promise<void> {\n    try {\n      // Hashing yields the host thread, so a newer task attempt, edit, archive\n      // or replacement team can win while the worker is running. Never apply\n      // the old answer to that new record, even when its artifact paths match.\n      const current = await readTeam(job.stateRoot, job.team.id)\n      if (current === undefined || JSON.stringify(current) !== job.source) {\n        audit = { ...audit, gaps: [...audit.gaps ?? [], { pattern: '(team revision)', reason: 'team state changed during the workspace audit; retry the current revision' }] }\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      audit = { ...audit, gaps: [...audit.gaps ?? [], { pattern: '(team revision)', reason: `team state could not be revalidated after the workspace audit: ${String(error)}` }] }\n    }\n    if (!this.jobs.delete(job)) return\n    job.complete(this.closed ? incomplete('workspace audit service was disposed before its result could be applied') : audit)\n  }\n\n  private failWorker(reason: string): Promise<number> | undefined {\n    const worker = this.worker\n    this.worker = undefined\n    this.active = undefined\n    clearTimeout(this.timer)\n    clearTimeout(this.idleTimer)\n    this.timer = undefined\n    this.idleTimer = undefined\n    this.queue.length = 0\n    for (const job of this.jobs) job.complete(incomplete(reason))\n    this.jobs.clear()\n    return worker?.terminate()\n  }\n\n  /** Unload cancels active/queued work; late replies can never restore a pass. */\n  async dispose(): Promise<void> {\n    this.closed = true\n    await this.failWorker('workspace audit was cancelled when its owner unloaded')\n  }\n}\n\nconst owners = new WeakMap<Context, WorkspaceAuditService>()\n\n/** Share tools/panel work and release the worker with its Cordis owner. */\nexport function workspaceAuditor(ctx: Context): WorkspaceAuditService {\n  let service = owners.get(ctx)\n  if (service !== undefined) return service\n  service = new WorkspaceAuditService()\n  owners.set(ctx, service)\n  const owned = service\n  ctx.effect(() => () => {\n    // A reloaded Cordis fiber gets a new Context. Keep this disposed owner's\n    // service so a late callback cannot start new work after unload.\n    return owned.dispose()\n  }, 'agent-teams: workspace audit worker')\n  return service\n}\n"

      "content": "/** Built worker entry: no Harness service instances cross the thread boundary. */\nimport { parentPort } from 'node:worker_threads'\nimport { auditTeamWorkspace } from './workspace-audit.ts'\nimport type { TeamState } from './types.ts'\n\nparentPort?.on('message', (job: { id: number; workspace: string; team: TeamState }) => {\n  try {\n    parentPort?.postMessage({ id: job.id, audit: auditTeamWorkspace(job.workspace, job.team) })\n  } catch (error) {\n    parentPort?.postMessage({ id: job.id, error: String(error) })\n  }\n})\n"

      "path": "src/workspace-audit.ts",
      "content": "/**\n * The single workspace audit shared by every surface that reports a delivery\n * or quality-loop conclusion.\n *\n * `agent_teams_status`, the activity-panel route and any Web API consumer must\n * read the same current bytes: if only one of them compared recorded verdicts\n * against the workspace, the other would keep advertising a passing gate over\n * a revision no review ever saw (issue #161).\n *\n * The audit consumes the artifact reader's *complete* result — digests, the\n * enumeration gaps and unreadable paths — because a partial read must never\n * look like a clean one: a scope that outgrew its cap after the review would\n * otherwise be reported as fully verified.\n * @module dsh-agent-teams/workspace-audit\n */\n\nimport { readArtifactScopes } from './artifacts.ts'\nimport { deliveryArtifactPaths, deliveryScopePatterns } from './quality-gates.ts'\nimport type { DeliveryAudit } from './quality-gates.ts'\nimport type { ArtifactDigest, ArtifactScopeGap, TeamState } from './types.ts'\n\n/**\n * Read the current workspace bytes a team's recorded verdicts and generated\n * work orders depend on.\n * @param workspace - absolute path of the owning workspace.\n * @param team - the durable team record.\n * @returns digests of every recorded path, the current contents of the scopes\n * the verdicts bound (so a new file cannot slip into a broad scope), and every\n * gap that makes this audit incomplete.\n */\nexport function auditTeamWorkspace(workspace: string, team: TeamState): DeliveryAudit {\n  const paths = deliveryArtifactPaths(team)\n  const scopePatterns = deliveryScopePatterns(team)\n  const [pathRead, scopeRead] = readArtifactScopes(workspace, [paths, scopePatterns]) as [\n    { artifacts: ArtifactDigest[]; gaps: ArtifactScopeGap[] },\n    { artifacts: ArtifactDigest[]; gaps: ArtifactScopeGap[] },\n  ]\n  const gaps: ArtifactScopeGap[] = []\n  const seen = new Set<string>()\n  const recordGap = (pattern: string, reason: string): void => {\n    const key = `${pattern}\\u0000${reason}`\n    if (seen.has(key)) return\n    seen.add(key)\n    gaps.push({ pattern, reason })\n  }\n  for (const gap of [...pathRead.gaps, ...scopeRead.gaps]) recordGap(gap.pattern, gap.reason)\n  for (const artifact of [...pathRead.artifacts, ...scopeRead.artifacts]) {\n    // An unreadable path is not a gap in enumeration but a gap in evidence:\n    // report it the same way so no surface treats it as a clean read.\n    if (artifact.unreadable === true) recordGap(artifact.path, artifact.reason ?? 'path could not be read')\n  }\n  return {\n    artifacts: pathRead.artifacts,\n    expandedScope: scopeRead.artifacts.map((artifact) => ({ path: artifact.path, present: artifact.present })),\n    ...gaps.length === 0 ? {} : { gaps },\n  }\n}\n"
